mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its recent level signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their prior month values, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal (both declining) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, INDPRO slowdowns (defined as a 3-month decline) are associated with positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d returns in late-cycle expansions is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 3.5%, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (the 2017 base) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reactions to monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
